canonical_title: Roll due to pitch coupling for aggressive agility

versions.title_at_revision: Roll due to pitch coupling for aggressive agility
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle's roll due to pitch coupling for aggressive agility in forward flight (greater than 45 KGS) is no worse than Level 2 flying qualities as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Roll due to Pitch Coupling for Aggressive Agility paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the roll due to pitch coupling for aggressive agility in forward flight as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Roll due to Pitch Coupling for Aggressive Agility paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the roll due to pitch coupling for aggressive agility in forward flight as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Roll due to Pitch Coupling for Aggressive Agility paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the roll due to pitch coupling for aggressive agility in forward flight as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Roll due to Pitch Coupling for Aggressive Agility paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE.
